laws.rule: Logarska dolina Landscape Park: entry is charged only for motor vehicles: motorbike €7 (about A$11.12 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), car €10 (about A$15.89 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), van €20 (about A$31.78 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), bus €70 (about A$111 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026); annual sticker car €30 (about A$47.67 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), van €100 (about A$159 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Free on foot or by bike. Guests staying several nights in Solčava municipality pay once for the whole stay (with the accommodation's confirmation).
